sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A columnar cactus from South America, often cultivated under the name Trichocereus macrogonus. Echinopsis macrogona is accepted by some taxonomic databases, while other treatments use Trichocereus.

sections.title: Stems and flowers
sections.text: It forms upright, ribbed, spiny stems and produces large night-blooming flowers. The taxonomic sources consulted do not consistently support a precise maximum height for this entry.

sections.title: Food use and toxicity
sections.text: The consulted sources do not establish food use or a particular toxicity for this species under this name; no consumption is recommended here.
